  <h2 class="proj-section__title">About the project</h2>
  <p>As part of the BAA1019 Business Strategy module, our group of six acted as a strategy consultancy, A & A Consultancy, tasked with producing a full strategic review of Superdry. The report examined how the brand captured value in its early years, why it declined through overexpansion and brand dilution, and what strategic interventions could restore its competitive position.</p>
  <p>The analysis followed a structured consulting process: Orientation, Diagnostics, Intervention, and Evaluation, applying frameworks including PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, SWOT, RBV/VRIO, and the Strategy Diamond to build a comprehensive picture of Superdry's strategic trade-offs.</p>
</div>

## Strategic data visualisation

The radar chart below maps the competitive intensity of each of Porter's Five Forces acting on Superdry, scored from 1 (low) to 5 (high) based on our group's strategic diagnostics.

```{python}
#| label: fig-porters
#| fig-cap: "Porter's Five Forces — Superdry competitive intensity (1 = low, 5 = high)"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

labels = ["Competitive\nRivalry", "Supplier\nPower", "Buyer\nPower", "Threat of\nSubstitution", "Threat of\nNew Entry"]
scores = [4, 3, 4, 4, 3]

N = len(labels)
angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, N, endpoint=False)
scores_ext = scores + [scores[0]]
angles_ext = np.append(angles, angles[0])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6), subplot_kw=dict(polar=True))
ax.plot(angles_ext, scores_ext, "o-", linewidth=2, color="#4a90d9")
ax.fill(angles_ext, scores_ext, alpha=0.2, color="#4a90d9")
ax.set_thetagrids(np.degrees(angles), labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 5)
ax.set_yticks([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
ax.set_yticklabels(["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"], fontsize=7, color="gray")
ax.set_title("Porter's Five Forces — Superdry", size=12, pad=20, fontweight="bold")
ax.grid(color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
